ChargesBreakdownOut.title: ChargesBreakdownOut
ChargesBreakdownOut.description: ADR-167 (2): the round trip by component, from the engine (Decimal strings); null on the outcome if unpriced.

CurveOut.title: CurveOut
CurveOut.description: REQ-083 AC-1/AC-3: one view's curve over the shared levels; unavailable -> no points and the reason.

CurvesOut.title: CurvesOut
CurvesOut.description: REQ-083 AC-1: both curves of one answer, on the same levels (``both_views``).

FundsShareOut.title: FundsShareOut
FundsShareOut.description:
ADR-164: max profit / max loss as a whole percent of Zerodha's available funds. The whole block is null (never
estimated) unless the margin read is CHECKED with positive funds; a side that is Unlimited has null percent/text.

planned_entry.title: Planned Entry
planned_entry.description: the planned entry price, a decimal string (never a float)

captured_at.title: Captured At
captured_at.description: when the planned entry was captured (ADR-068)

LegQuoteOut.title: LegQuoteOut
LegQuoteOut.description: REQ-035 AC-5 / ADR-168 (5): Bid/Ask for everyone, in the leg quotes. Taken from the same snapshot as the table (one read).

MarginOut.title: MarginOut
MarginOut.description: ADR-099: Zerodha's margin for the planned orders. The figures are present only in the CHECKED state.

NetPremiumOut.title: NetPremiumOut
NetPremiumOut.description:
REQ-081 AC-1: the net premium at the planned entries. ``amount`` / ``side`` are null (with a ``reason``) when a
leg has no planned price or a leg is a future; ``side`` is null for exactly zero; ``per_unit`` is null when the
legs' quantities differ.

OiRowOut.title: OiRowOut
OiRowOut.description: One strike's bars: a side with no usable OI is null with a dash, never 0; a real 0 is 0 / "0".

OpenInterestOut.title: OpenInterestOut
OpenInterestOut.description: REQ-083 AC-5 / AC-6 (``open_interest``): the OI bars for ``expiry`` over the scenario range, or ONE reason.

range_start.title: Range Start
range_start.description: the first scenario level in index points; sent with range_end

range_end.title: Range End
range_end.description: the last scenario level in index points; sent with range_start

fallback.title: Fallback
fallback.description: true when this is the REST refresh of a screen whose own live socket dropped (ADR-077): the answer is then the not-live state whoever else subscribes to the same contracts

anyOf.description: the request's sequence id; the reply echoes it unchanged as seq

both_views.title: Both Views
both_views.description: REQ-083 AC-1: true asks for both curves (At Expiry and Estimated Now) over the same levels in `curves`, and the other view's totals in `scenario.other`; false keeps today's reply exactly

payoff_step.title: Payoff Step
payoff_step.description: REQ-137 AC-1: the payoff table's interval in index points, one of 10, 25, 50, 100; the reply then carries `payoff_table` (also sent with both_views; absent: the strike step, NIFTY 50, SENSEX 100)

sd_bands.title: Sd Bands
sd_bands.description: REQ-083 AC-4 / REQ-137 AC-3: true adds `standard_deviation` (1 SD and 2 SD on a fixed 7-day horizon, the days to expiry when fewer)

open_interest.title: Open Interest
open_interest.description: REQ-083 AC-5 / AC-6: true adds `open_interest`: each listed strike inside the reply's scenario range with its call and put OI for the strategy's expiry (a calendar: the nearest) and the time read, or the reason OI is not available; false keeps today's reply exactly. Today's OI change is not offered (D-B18, Later)

target_level.title: Target Level
target_level.description: REQ-084 AC-1: the what-if index level in points; the server clamps it to `target.limits` (spot -10% .. +10%, snapped to the strike step). Analysis only: never saved, never feeds margin (AC-6)

target_at.title: Target At
target_at.description: REQ-084 AC-2: the what-if date-time; the server clamps it between now and the strategy's first expiry at 15:30 IST (`target.at_clamped`, `target.clamp`). Analysis only (AC-6)

ScenarioOtherOut.title: ScenarioOtherOut
ScenarioOtherOut.description: REQ-083 AC-1 (both views asked for): the other view's totals on the scenario table's own levels.

TargetGreeksOut.title: TargetGreeksOut
TargetGreeksOut.description:
Position Greeks at the target, one row per leg in leg order (null: that leg has no time left) and the total
(null unless every leg has a value; ``unavailable`` names why).

TargetOut.title: TargetOut
TargetOut.description:
REQ-084 AC-1/AC-2/AC-4/AC-7 (``target_level`` / ``target_at``): the clamped inputs and every engine figure at
the target. ``kind`` "estimate" (the pricing model, ``model``) or "exact" (At Expiry only: no IV or no live data,
the time refused with ``at_refused_reason``).
